title: Borrowing a canoe for a weekend
intro: An invented checklist for the fixture trip: every place, person and number in it is made up.
disclaimer: One paddler's notes, not advice. Ask the boathouse.

steps.title: Call the boathouse
steps.detail: Confirm the canoe is free and ask what time the gate opens.
steps.private: PRIVATE-FIXTURE the keeper is Juniper Quillfeather

steps.title: Look the hull over
steps.detail: Photograph any scratch before it goes on the roof.

questions.ask: Do the paddles come with it?
questions.why: Otherwise two have to be found on the way.
questions.private: PRIVATE-FIXTURE ask for Juniper by name

questions.ask: Is there a fee for a late return?
Will it fit a short roof?
